new.name: RESOLVES_AMBIGUITY_BY_DEFERRING_TO_OBSERVED_BEHAVIOR
new.definition: Reasoning identifies an ambiguity or conflict in the specification or expected behavior and resolves it by treating the concrete behavior reported in an observation as authoritative, adapting its subsequent decision accordingly.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text that names the ambiguity and adopts the observed behavior as authoritative.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting the concrete behavior that settles the ambiguity.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning explicitly identifies an ambiguity or conflict between the stated requirement and expected behavior.
The reasoning adopts the concrete outcome reported in the observation as the reference fact and adjusts its decision to match it.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning uses the observation as general support without any identified ambiguity.
The observation does not concern the ambiguity in question.
The reasoning continues to speculate about the requirement instead of deferring to the observed behavior.

new.name: VERIFIES_EFFECT_OF_PRIOR_ACTION
new.definition: A check action inspects observable state produced by an earlier state-changing action in order to establish whether that change actually took effect, independently of the earlier action's own reported result.

parameters.name: modification_action
parameters.description: The earlier action that changes persistent or runtime state.

parameters.name: verification_action
parameters.description: The later action that inspects state to confirm the effect of the change.

assertion_conditions: The modification action changes state whose effect is independently observable (process status, logs, files, or a listening endpoint).
The verification action reads such state specifically to determine the effect of the modification action.
exclusion_conditions: The verification action inspects state unrelated to the modification action.
The verification action gathers information for an unrelated purpose rather than confirming the modification's effect.
The two actions are merely adjacent in time without an inspection of the modification's effect.

uncertain.name: CORRECTS_ERROR_WITH_REVISED_ACTION
uncertain.definition: Reasoning diagnoses the cause of a reported failure of a prior operation, and the agent then re-issues that operation with the diagnosed cause removed.

parameters.name: error_observation
parameters.description: The observation reporting that the prior operation failed or was rejected.

parameters.name: diagnosis_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that attributes the failure to a specific cause.

parameters.name: corrective_action
parameters.description: The revised action that repeats the intended operation with the diagnosed cause addressed.

assertion_conditions: The observation reports an error or failed validation of the prior operation.
The reasoning explicitly names the cause of that failure.
The corrective action repeats the intended operation in a form that removes the named cause.
exclusion_conditions: The operation is retried unchanged without any diagnosis of the reported cause.
The reasoning is unrelated to the reported failure.
The subsequent action abandons the operation or addresses an unrelated problem.
